task_title: Add loading screen with progress bar

plan_review.notes: Reviewed BootScene loading screen and MainGameScene floor transition progress bar plan. Blocking bug found: progress listener active during second load cycle overwrites bar progress — fixed by calling load.off('progress') at top of loadGeneratedSpritesAndStartGame(). Non-blocking: FILE_LOAD_ERROR not counted, bar stalls on failed sprites — fixed by adding FILE_LOAD_ERROR listener. Minor: floorCompletionScreen?.destroy() missing before null — added. All three concerns resolved before code review.

rounds.notes: Reviewed all five flagged areas. progress/fileprogress listener cleanup correct before second load cycle. FILE_COMPLETE/FILE_LOAD_ERROR dual-listener cleanup correct in finalize(). Tween edge case on scene restart safe (Phaser destroys tweens on shutdown). Container destroy correct and positioned before null assignment. setScrollFactor(0) with absolute game-space coordinates works correctly. No issues found.
